note: The models ninferno-ui recommends. Measured numbers are single-request decode tok/s on short prompts (ours with --spec auto, and llama.cpp at the same quantization) and the longest single-request context the cell was measured at; they come from our measurements. Sizes are read from the hub listing at run time. A GPU without its own measurement gets an estimate scaled by memory bandwidth from the nearest measured card. A model's load list is the decode of one request among C parallel requests, without and with speculation, from our load runs: per_request at the first depth, and by_depth the cells at each depth (prompt tokens, decode of one request and of all, prefill, and whether the KV pool held every request whole; pool gives its size). The page interpolates between depths and counts on log scales and scales across cards and quants by bandwidth.
